movie.title: Barreda
movie.overview: A fictionalized drama film based on one of the most shocking crimes in Argentina's history. In 1992, Ricardo Barreda was an unassuming dentist, brutally murdered his wife, mother-in-law, and two adult daughters in their family home. Branding himself as a victim, Ricardo Barreda ignited a media storm and fueled a national scandal.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: In 1992 Argentina, an unassuming dentist brutally murders his entire family, setting off a sensational media storm as he claims to be the true victim.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: A fictionalized retelling of one of Argentina's most infamous real-life crimes, this drama explores the 1992 massacre committed by Ricardo Barreda. Behind the façade of a quiet, respectable dentist, Barreda brutally murders his wife, mother-in-law, and two adult daughters inside their home. He then attempts to manipulate the narrative, framing himself as a long-suffering victim to captivate the press and outrage the nation.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Set in 1992, the film dramatizes the shocking true events surrounding Ricardo Barreda, a seemingly ordinary dentist living in La Plata, Argentina. Beneath the quiet routine of his bourgeois household lies toxic domestic tension, which culminates in an explosion of unthinkable violence. In a single horrifying act, Barreda guns down his wife, his mother-in-law, and his two adult daughters inside their family residence. Rather than immediately fleeing or showing remorse, he orchestrates a calculated cover-up and attempts to paint himself as the abused target of relentless psychological harassment. As police unravel the crime scene, Barreda's cool, unrepentant demeanor shocks investigators and captivates the national press. The media frenzy amplifies his claims, turning a brutal domestic slaughter into a polarizing public debate on family dynamics, abuse, and justice. The narrative delves into the psychological chillingness of the perpetrator alongside the legal and journalistic aftermath. Ultimately, the film offers a grim look at how a devastating multi-homicide became one of the most sensationalized national scandals in modern Argentine history.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: A chilling crime drama based on infamous true events, this film delves into the dark psychological reality and explosive public aftermath of the 1992 Barreda murders in Argentina. Centering on Ricardo Barreda—a suburban dentist whose unremarkable exterior hides a deadly potential—the narrative examines the shocking destruction of his household and the subsequent media circus that gripped a nation.

story_structure.climax: The truth behind the massacre comes to light, leading to Barreda's arrest and his startling public attempts to frame himself as the true victim of systemic domestic abuse.
story_structure.conflict: Beneath the domestic facade, severe interpersonal friction and deep-seated hostility simmer continuously between Barreda and the women in his household, pushing the domestic environment toward a breaking point.
story_structure.resolution: A sensational media storm and national scandal engulf Argentina as the legal process unfolds, forcing society to confront the shocking nature of the crime and Barreda's polarising public defense.
story_structure.introduction: Ricardo Barreda leads an outwardly quiet life as an unassuming dentist in La Plata, Argentina, living under the same roof with his wife, mother-in-law, and two adult daughters.
story_structure.risingAction: Tensions within the household escalate dramatically until a violent flashpoint occurs in 1992, leading to the brutal murder of all four family members and Barreda's initial attempts to obscure his role in the crime.
